name: jp.pokkur.vacuum
description: Dependency-free generic mesh suction (genie-effect). Tag a mesh with SuctionAbsorbable, drive a nozzle with SuctionSource, and pull objects into a single point with a 5-state lifecycle. Source-centric config: the nozzle owns acquisition (Volume / Raycast), motion profile, shape, max concurrent targets, and optional category filtering. No external package dependencies.

samples.description: A nozzle plus varied suctionable targets (some moving, some too strong to absorb).
